title: Ratio of Singaporeans to Foreigners in Autonomous Universities for Faculty Members
what_it_is: Ratio of Singaporeans to Foreigners in Autonomous Universities for Faculty Members

sections.label: Singaporean faculty proportions in AUs
sections.summary: About 50% of faculty in Humanities and Social Sciences departments are Singaporean, with stable tenure-track and higher non-tenure proportions.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Based on available data over the past five years, the proportion of Singaporean faculty in the Humanities and Social Sciences-related departments in our AUs is around 50%.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: For National University of Singapore (NUS), Nanyang Technological University (NTU), Singapore Management University (SMU) and Singapore University of Technology and Design (SUTD), which have a tenure system, the proportion of Singaporeans in tenured and tenure-track faculty has remained stable at around 40% over the past 10 years.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: For faculty on the non-tenure track, the proportion of Singaporeans is higher, averaging at around 60% over the past 10 years.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: The AUs actively reach out to Singaporean academics based overseas to attract them to come back to Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: We also support young Singaporeans keen on pursuing an academic career at the AUs through the Singapore Teaching and Academic Research Talent Scheme (START) which was introduced in 2015.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: There are 162 START award recipients to date.
